links.outcome: Standalone sensitivity and false-positive rate of DLAD on local retrospective chest radiographs against CT-based reference standard
links.effect: DLAD detected 222 of 322 visible nodules, sensitivity 0.689, false-positive rate 0.168; lower detection for small, subsolid nodules and overlapping structures.
links.quote: The DLAD software detected 222 of the 322 nodules visible on manual evaluation, with a sensitivity of 0.689 and a false-positive rate of 0.168.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating imaging AI detection performance stratified by nodule size, density, location, visibility, and overlapping structures or background lung disease

screen.reason: Evaluates the standalone diagnostic performance and failure modes (subgroup analysis by nodule characteristics and background lung condition) of commercially available deep learning software on a retrospective clinical dataset without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
